paragraphs.text:
The shore seems devoid of berries, game, or anything else to eat. 
Your concentration and reflexes noticeably impaired, you are 
reduced to wandering the shoals of the riverside, attempting to 
spear fish with a sharpened pole.
Around one bend, however, you find an abandoned canoe.

To use the canoe to dare the rough water ahead, go to 242. To leave 
it behind, go to 119.
